simulator.note: Boots on C3505 (chips/c3505.py, front_panel.py, run_dump_gtmedia_v9_super_v400_app_starts.py, run_dump_gtmedia_v9_super_v400_capture_screen.py): the "M3505---0.1.0" boot-ROM bootloader at 0x800 runs at 0x9FE00800, copies its payload to 0x8100EF00, writes "boot" (0xB6, 0x36, 0x36, 0xA6) to the FD650 4-digit LED panel on GPIO 107 (SCL) / 110 (SDA), unpacks the 8.89 MB Main Code to 0x80000200 and M3505 SEE to 0xA6000200, and starts the dual-CPU application (which updates the FD650 panel through " on " to "Strt").  Because the MP (Mass Production) image carries an unprogrammed serial placeholder in its platform chunk at 0x06FE00, the application opens its 1280x720 "Factory Test Page" OSD ("Model: GTMedia V9 Super[P]", "SW Ver: V210.400", "HW Ver: Oct 20 2020") through the GE and display-engine list DMA.

desc: GTMedia V9 Super mass-production firmware V400 (V210.400, 2020-10-20) on an 8 MB SPI flash image for the Full HD H.265/HEVC DVB-S2 satellite receiver on the dual-CPU ALi M3505 / C3505 SoC with 128 MB DDR3.

Drives an FD650 4-digit 7-segment display ("PAN_FD650_0") on GPIO 107 (SCL) / 110 (SDA) with custom segment wiring and boots into its 1280x720 "Factory Test Page" OSD when the platform serial number is unprogrammed.
